acceptance_criteria.criterion: IInmaDynamicFieldsClient (Shared/Contracts/Inma/) + HttpInmaDynamicFieldsClient impl + InmaDynamicField DTO — POST /api/dynamicfields + X-CIB-SecretKey auth + typed catch (HttpRequestException/TaskCanceledException/JsonException) + 5s timeout.

InmaDynamicFieldsCache — tenant-level IMemoryCache (key: inma:dynamicfields:{tenantId}) 1h TTL + single-flight coalescing (ConcurrentDictionary _inflight) + manual invalidate endpoint POST /api/v1/dynamic-fields/cache-invalidate. Auth: tenant-scoped JWT (same gate as GET) — iter 3 decision, admin-role NOT required because tenants can only drop their own cache slot and single-flight caps upstream fetch at 1 per concurrent-wave.

PlaceholderPicker.tsx component — /api/v1/dynamic-fields data + hybrid display: TFM mapping service hook (boş hook TFM gelene kadar) → semantic varsa '{{roadshow_city}}' ve tooltip 'INMA CF1 → Sehir', yoksa '{{cf1}}' ve tooltip fieldName. MessageText cursor-pos insert.

Send-time validation (BroadcastOrchestrator + AutomationOrchestrator callback build): MessageText regex scan → all {{x}} placeholders. TFM resolver DI optional — varsa semantic→INMA key resolve, yoksa raw. Miss = INV-OB-033 DynamicFieldValidationFailed warn log + **backward-compat fall-through** (recipient.Variables ile INSE substitute çalışmaya devam eder; reject-send değil). AC3 + AC4: bridge sadece non-empty (length > 0) ise DynamicMessage=true yazmali, empty array da legacy pipeline'a dusmeli. Bu koruma yazildi mi?

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: AC8 invalid-placeholder stratejisi: WARN + FALL-THROUGH (reject-send DEGIL) — iter 0 Codex CQ9 FAIL sonucu yeniden degerlendirildi.
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Spec'in ilk draft'inda 'callback reddedilir' yaziyordu; ancak kodbase'de legacy `{{order_id}}` gibi user-variable placeholder'lari meşru — TemplateEngine.Substitute recipient.Variables'tan doldurmayi bekler. Reject-send bu legacy flow'lari kirar (Dent pilotundan önce rollout blokeri olur). Fall-through + INV-OB-033 warn log ops dashboard'da görünür kalir, tenant bazli disable için `enable_dynamic_message=FALSE` mevcut. Risk: INMA side real 901/902/903/905 yanit prod'da UI'a yine yansir (bridge ExtractWapStatusCode dallandirmasi iter 1'de eklendi).
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: AC8 IsValid=false yolunda reject YOK, SystemWarn + legacy path fall-through. Bu silent-failure DEGIL (warn log + outbound_messages.status='failed' INMA gerçek reject'inde gecerli). Intentional design change from initial spec draft.

BU DOWNGRADE EXPECTED; flag intentionally escape hatch.
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Interview Q5 (2026-04-20): FALSE kullanimi tenant-side INMA sorun yasadiginda admin'in hizli kill-switch'idir. Downgrade davranisi surprise DEGIL — admin tenant'a 'flag'i FALSE yapayim, kisa sureli raw placeholder'li mesajlar gidebilir; siz template'leri INSE pipeline'a uygun halde guncelleyin' der. Iter 0 Codex Q3 FAIL 'under-specified' sonucu nedeniyle bu decision plan'a eklenmistir.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: FALSE path Automation'da {{cf1}} → raw text olarak gider (INMA tarafi substitute etmez). Dashboard alert YOK (admin kasitli kullanir), UI picker hala goru̇nur (tenant template save edebilir, sadece send path downgrade). Future enhancement: admin banner (scope-disi).

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: OutboundRepository.InsertMessageAsync parametre sirasi: `dynamicFields` `CancellationToken ct`'den SONRA konuldu (iter 3 CQ8 fix). BatchInsertMessagesAsync icin de iki-tuple (phone, text) forward-compat overload eklendi (null dynamicFields ile yeni signature'a delegate eder).
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Iter 2 Codex CQ8 FAIL: `dynamicFields` once ct'den once konulmustu, mevcut `(..., lang, ct)` pozisyonel cagirilari semantik olarak kirabilirdi (build sorunsuz ama gelecek refactor riski). Iter 3: (a) InsertMessageAsync signature'i `(..., lang=null, ct=default, dynamicFields=null)` ile yeniden duzenlendi, TriggerProcessor named-arg gereksinimi ortadan kalkti; (b) BatchInsertMessagesAsync icin legacy 2-tuple overload FEAT-DMP oncesi external test/integration callers icin kopru gorevi gorur.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: CQ8 breaking-risk artik yok — signature'lar backward-compatible. Overload helper sadece migration bufferi, FEAT-DMP sonrasi yeni kod dogrudan 3-tuple kullanmali.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: OutboundRepository.DequeueMessagesAsync cross-tenant claim pattern KORUNDU (iter 6 CQ9 clarification). FEAT-DMP sadece RETURNING list'e dynamic_fields kolonunu ekledi, WHERE filter semantigi degismedi.
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Outbound servisi MessageSenderService singleton background worker — tenant context YOK dequeue asamasinda. Queue tum tenant'larin queued mesajlarini zaman siralamasinda FIFO draine eder; FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED ile multi-instance safe. Dequeue'dan sonra her satir kendi tenant_id'sini RETURNING ile getirir, SendMessageAsync callback icin tenant scope'u yeniden kurar. GR-2.3'ten (2026-02-15) bu yana kullanilan design. FEAT-DMP'nin scope'u outbox queue semantigini degistirmek DEGIL.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: DequeueMessagesAsync WHERE clause'inda tenant_id filter YOK. Bu 'tenant isolation violation' DEGIL — singleton worker cross-tenant queue drain pattern, tenant_id per-row storage (NOT NULL) + per-row return + per-message callback tenant scope. FEAT-DMP diff'inde dynamic_fields sadece RETURNING'e eklendi; claim logic korundu.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: /api/v1/dynamic-fields/cache-invalidate admin-role gate YOK — tenant-scoped JWT yeterli (iter 3 AC2 refinement).
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Iter 2 Codex Q5 FAIL 'policy/contract mismatch AC2 admin auth'. Analiz: (1) tenant kendi cache slot'unu drop edebilir — baska tenant'i etkilemez (izolasyon guvenli); (2) single-flight _inflight ConcurrentDictionary ile N concurrent GET = 1 upstream fetch (stampede kapatildi); (3) admin-role check gereksinimi sadece cross-tenant etkisi olan islemler icin anlamli (tenant impersonation, super-admin dashboards). Kendi kaynagini yonetmek admin privilege istemez. AC2 metni iter 3'te bu realite ile hizalandi.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: /api/v1/dynamic-fields/cache-invalidate endpoint'inde `role == 'admin'` check YOK. Bu 'missing auth' bug DEGIL, AC2 intentional downgrade with stampede guard (InmaDynamicFieldsCache._inflight) as compensating control.
